value: In a gPPI analysis with the PAG seed, cocaine versus neutral cue exposure showed positive connectivity of the PAG with the ventromedial prefrontal cortex and left inferior frontal gyrus. PAG-vmPFC connectivity strength was positively correlated with tonic cocaine craving in men and negatively correlated in women, suggesting sex differences in the role of PAG-vmPFC connectivity in cocaine craving.
